diffs.diff: header pin 6 (SCK): part says gnd, datasheet reading says io
diffs.evidence: TI PCM5102A datasheet (SLAS859C) pin table: 'SCK 12 I System clock input'; section 9.3: 'if BCK and LRCK start correctly while SCK remains at ground level for 16 successive LRCK periods, then the internal PLL starts, automatically generating an internal SCK from the BCK reference.' The model uses 3-wire mode with no MCLK, and for the GY-PCM5102 module the documented wiring is SCK to GND: mt32-pi wiki pinout 'SCK 9 (unused, grounded)', todbot 'SCK - Gnd' / 'connect PCM5102 SCK pin to Gnd'. In this library, role 'gnd' marks a pin to tie to ground (same as 74HC595 OE and 74HC165 CLK INH). The second reading lists the chip-level input type (io, optional); the model's gnd role is the correct wiring for this product, and its description notes it is the system clock input.
